# Town of Whiting municipal roster backfill -- Vermont
# municipal fan-out batch 27; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Vermont Selectboard Members' directory (updated June 5, 2026): lists only Steven Quenneville for Whiting -- a thin directory entry

Town of Whiting, Selectboard minutes (town site): the August 24, 2026 minutes' attendance line names the board as 'SB- Bob Wood, Steve Quenneville, Marcia King'; the July 27, 2026 minutes concur. The minutes print 'Bob' and 'Steve'; the directory and factory full forms (Robert Wood, Steven Quenneville, Marcia King) govern the person names
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town clerk
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Heather Bouchard as Whiting's Town Clerk
Town of Whiting, Town Clerk page: Heather Bouchard is the Town Clerk and also the Town Treasurer
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a town treasurer
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, and County Officials' (January 2026): lists Heather Bouchard as Whiting's Town Treasurer
Town of Whiting, Town Clerk page: 'The Treasurer is an elected position' and the clerk, Heather Bouchard, holds it
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of listers
Town of Whiting, Lister Board page: Stacey Freeguard, Marguerite 'Peg' Allen, and Rani Fallon
17 V.S.A. section 2646: towns elect a board of auditors
Town of Whiting, Auditors page: Alison Remy, Suzanne Denis, and Pat Mattison
17 V.S.A. section 2646 establishes the office (towns elect a moderator for a one-year term); no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
Town of Whiting, town site: no page or document on the town's comprehensive site names the moderator, so the holder is unpublished
